📋 How to Use These Prototypes

For Developers:

  • Reference the visual design when implementing UI components
  • Check layout, spacing, and component hierarchy
  • Verify interactive states (hover, focus, active)
  • Ensure responsive behavior matches prototypes
  • Use CSS variables from the design system for consistency

For QA:

  • Use prototypes as visual references for expected behavior
  • Test all interactive elements shown in prototypes
  • Verify DSL ↔ Diagram synchronization works correctly
  • Check filters, search, and sorting functionality
  • Validate responsive design on different screen sizes
  • Test drag-and-drop functionality
  • Verify all buttons, inputs, and controls are accessible

Notes:

  • Each prototype includes QA test notes in yellow/blue annotation boxes
  • Prototypes are interactive (click, drag, hover)
  • Check that implemented features match prototype behavior
  • Report any discrepancies between prototype and implementation
